how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-thousand-needles-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1194:obj:0: Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1194:details:0: Rizzle's schematics describe the process of the refinement of indurium ore. From his scrawls, it is apparent that indurium ore is being obtained from the dwarven excavation site of Uldaman in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1194:details:1: BMuch of the other notes relate to the heat resistant properties.
rows.quest:1194:details:2: BUsed as a paperweight for the plans is a hunk of what appears to be unrefined indurium ore.
rows.quest:1194:completion:0: Indurium? Interesting... If it is capable of resisting heat to the degree that you say, it would explain the performance increase the gnomes have displayed of late.
rows.quest:1194:completion:1: BThis sample you've brought to me will be invaluable, also. I will be able to perform some tests on this, but I'll need more for this to actually be of any use to us.
rows.quest:1394:details:0: You have done well, ⟦1⟧. You have passed my test, and the tests before mine. Return to Dorn in ⟦E2⟧. He will sense the change within you, and see that your mind, body and spirit are strong enough that you should be rewarded for your efforts.
rows.quest:1394:details:1: BStay true to the balance you've shown throughout these trials, ⟦2⟧. Dorn will test you again in the future if you do.
rows.quest:1394:completion:0: Ah, ⟦3⟧. It has been a long time since you have last stepped into my home. It seems like many moons have passed since you took your first leap that set you upon your path.
rows.quest:1394:completion:1: BAnd now you return to me stronger than you once were... more enlightened. This pleases me. And you should be justly rewarded for seeing my tests to the end.
rows.quest:2769:obj:0: Speak with Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:2769:details:0: Have you met the Brassbolts brothers? They're over in the Shimmering Flats, in ⟦E3⟧, racing their rocket car against the goblins. They usually win which is no surprise--the goblin car blows up so much it barely ever crosses the finish line!
rows.quest:2769:details:1: BBut even then, the Brassbolts brothers are always looking for new ways to make their car go faster, and Wizzle told me he needs a very rare component for his next experiment.
rows.quest:2769:details:2: BHe probably needs help getting that part. Speak to him and find out.
rows.quest:2769:completion:0: Ah, you want to help me? Great!
rows.quest:2769:completion:1: BThere's a part I want for an experiment I'm working on, and I need a brave ⟦4⟧ like you to help me get it!
rows.quest:4542:obj:0: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4542:details:0: Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.
rows.quest:4542:details:1: BBe warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
rows.quest:4542:completion:0: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!⟦5⟧
rows.quest:4767:obj:0: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4767:details:0: I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:4767:details:1: BI need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.
rows.quest:4767:completion:0: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:4770:obj:0: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.
rows.quest:4770:details:0: Please help me, ⟦8⟧! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.
rows.quest:4770:details:1: BI need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.
rows.quest:4770:details:2: BWhitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!
rows.quest:4770:completion:0: Whats! If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to ⟦E2⟧. We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.
rows.quest:4770:completion:1: BI appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.
rows.quest:4821:obj:0: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4821:details:0: A rumor has surfaced about an alien egg here in ⟦E2⟧. Those that report seeing this egg have failed to even get close enough to examine it in detail. Serpents guard the egg as if it's one of their own.
rows.quest:4821:details:1: BI want you to seek out this alien egg and bring it to me so that I may examine it. Reports say the egg is located within a serpent den, but there are several serpent dens along the base of the cliff walls south and northeast of Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4821:completion:0: Yes, finally... the mysterious egg has finally been delivered to me. Now, let me take a closer look at this... What..! What is this..?⟦9⟧
rows.quest:4841:obj:0: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4841:details:0: ⟦10⟧, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post! Let wrath guide your hand!⟦11⟧
rows.quest:4841:completion:0: For my gratitude, this is for you, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:4865:obj:0: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.
rows.quest:4865:details:0: If I did not see that with my own eyes I would never have believed it to be true. ⟦E4⟧ has come to ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:4865:details:2: B⟦14⟧, you must act quickly! Go now and seek out Motega Firemane; he is located at Whitereach Post just northwest of Freewind Post along the road. He will know what to do!
rows.quest:4865:completion:0: ⟦E4⟧! So, the legend of Arikara is true. Indeed, this is a problem that must be resolved immediately.
rows.quest:4881:obj:0: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.
rows.quest:4881:details:0: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in ⟦E2⟧. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.⟦15⟧
rows.quest:4881:completion:0: They come to kill me? I will show them how a Tauren fights!
rows.quest:4904:obj:0: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.
rows.quest:4904:details:0: Arnak thinks we're going to be married... but after I declined his offer he came back that night and kidnapped me. My brother tried to stop him, but Arnak was too strong. He... he slew my brother and then brought me here. My poor brother...
rows.quest:4904:details:1: B⟦16⟧, could you escort me out of the Darkcloud Pinnacle? Please... I need to get back to Thalia! She must be worried sick about me.
rows.quest:4904:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦17⟧. Deep in my bones I knew that she would find her way back to me. She told me of your bravery and how you helped her escape. These items belonged to her brother. I know she would want you to have them.
rows.quest:4966:obj:0: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.
rows.quest:4966:details:0: But, there may be more centaur than I thought, I ask you, ⟦18⟧, to fight with me against these vile assassins.
rows.quest:4966:completion:0: Thank you for your help, ⟦19⟧. I couldn't have held them off without you.
rows.quest:5062:obj:0: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.
rows.quest:5062:details:0: Arikara is a deadly creature that must be dealt with swiftly. In order to hunt her down you will need to light the sacred fire of life - this will summon Arikara.
rows.quest:5062:details:1: BGo now and harvest the rare Incendia agave plant. Once you have harvested enough agave, seek council with Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in ⟦E5⟧. She is a powerful shaman that can enchant the agave plant to create a powder that will light the fire.
rows.quest:5062:details:2: BTravel northeast to the Boiling Pool and gather Incendia Agave.
rows.quest:5062:completion:0: Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. This rare herb found only in ⟦E2⟧ will help light the dormant sacred fire of life.
rows.quest:5062:completion:1: B<Magatha begins to enchant the Incendia agave.>
rows.quest:5064:obj:0: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
rows.quest:5064:details:0: ⟦20⟧, you have served us well in the past, so I now entrust to you an important mission. The Grimtotem Clan is up to something secretive. Three agents of unknown origin were seen visiting the Grimtotem over the recent weeks. We discovered that separate chests in Darkcloud Pinnacle hold these guarded messages.
rows.quest:5064:details:1: B⟦21⟧, if you succeed in this dangerous mission, I will reward you in kind.⟦22⟧
rows.quest:5064:completion:0: Great Spirit Totem! This is dire news indeed. I must begin to plan for whatever may come.
rows.quest:5064:completion:1: B⟦23⟧, as promised, here is your reward for your brave service.
rows.quest:5088:obj:0: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.
rows.quest:5088:details:0: Take this refined and purified Incendia powder to ⟦E2⟧ and toss it on the sacred fire of life. It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.
rows.quest:5088:details:1: BThe enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:5088:details:2: BI fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. Move quickly before all is lost, ⟦25⟧!
rows.quest:5088:completion:0: This does not make sense. Why would Arikara be after Cairne Bloodhoof? Magatha could not be wrong, she is our most powerful shaman.
rows.quest:5088:completion:2: BRegardless, your great deed to the ⟦E6⟧ shall not go unnoticed - please, choose one of these as a reward for your aid.
rows.quest:5147:obj:0: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
rows.quest:5147:details:1: BArnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.
rows.quest:5147:details:2: BArnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.
rows.quest:5147:completion:0: Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!
rows.quest:5147:completion:1: BHere you are, ⟦27⟧... and thanks. News of Anrak's foul deeds boiled my blood!
rows.quest:5151:obj:0: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.
rows.quest:5151:details:0: I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!
rows.quest:5151:details:1: BHere is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.
rows.quest:5151:details:2: BThe wrecked caravan is just north of here.⟦28⟧
rows.quest:5151:completion:0: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...
rows.quest:5361:obj:0: Deliver Cliffwatcher Longhorn Report to Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:5361:details:0: My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in ⟦E7⟧. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed.
rows.quest:5361:details:1: BJourney to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into ⟦E7⟧; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.
rows.quest:5361:completion:0: I know not what connection you have with my brother but it would seem he has trust with you, ⟦29⟧.
rows.quest:5361:completion:1: BI am Nataka Longhorn and would like to welcome you to Ghost Walker Post, we have many needs of a ⟦30⟧! Talk with others, perhaps there is need of you here.
rows.quest:5762:obj:0: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:5762:details:0: I have a package for an old customer of mine, a dwarf named Hemet Nesingwary. The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now. He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could.
rows.quest:5762:details:1: BHemet's a rich dwarf and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah? So... you want to deliver the package for me?
rows.quest:5762:details:2: BI heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
rows.quest:5762:completion:0: Great, my package from Koalbeard! Thank you ⟦31⟧. This crate holds special-gauge ammunition, and it'll serve us well out in the jungle!
rows.quest:5762:completion:1: BHere's your pay, and tell me, how is crusty old Kravel these days? Still up to no good I'd wager...
rows.quest:6627:obj:0: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in ⟦E8⟧ when you are ready.
rows.quest:6627:details:0: You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?
rows.quest:6627:details:1: BTime is not an issue, ⟦32⟧, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.
rows.quest:6627:completion:0: Well done, ⟦33⟧. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
rows.quest:6628:obj:0: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the ⟦E9⟧ until you are ready.
rows.quest:6628:details:0: So the time is once again upon us. As a student of lore, you have shown great tenacity by undertaking my task.
rows.quest:6628:details:1: BAnd so now I offer you your question. If you are ready, speak to me again, and take all the time you need, ⟦34⟧--there is no pressure to answer quickly.
rows.quest:6628:completion:0: Well done, ⟦35⟧. I had my doubts if you studied the text I asked you to get, but you've answered correctly.
